name: flashscore
description: Public identity and competition metadata for the fixture Flashscore selects from a known football team-pair link. The route does not uniquely select a date or event.

operations.description: Resolve the fixture selected by a known Flashscore football team-pair link. Identity and competition metadata only; selection can change.
